meta.producto: Cardboard packaging boxes are being folded and assembled.
meta.operacion: The left hand typically holds and stabilizes the cardboard workpiece while the right hand folds the flaps or marks the material.
meta.lugar: Supply areas: white bins (left) and green conveyor (right). Work point: white table surface in the center. Waste/finished area: bottom center.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the bottom center. The left hand (L) appears on the left side of the image, and the right hand (R) appears on the right side.
meta.title_en: Cardboard box folding at a packing station (factory video, CC BY 4.0)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B (4-bit QAT) on a cloud NVIDIA A100 with vLLM; vision model only, no human review (development run)
meta.licencia_en: Video: Factory Manipulation Videos by Procedural Robotics Inc. (huggingface.co/datasets/procedural-robotics/factory-manipulation-videos), CC BY 4.0. Excerpt 60-210 s of cardboard_manipulation_station04_worker026.mp4, re-encoded; chart computed by Gilbreth.
